card.name: Opening quotes around contested social terms
card.fires_on: Opening quotation marks (and a few linking words) just before a quoted loaded term in social-justice, race or inequality writing, such as "blaming-the-victim" or 'legal' codes.

card.plain: It fires on the quote mark that opens a loaded phrase in writing about race, inequality and oppression.
